name: Rascal: Rat Rod v1 + Coprime Loader
blurb: Rat Rod v1 base stack (11-layer flat, Parallel Muon, XSA-all-11, BigramHash 2048, RoPE 16, late QAT) + coprime-stride multi-shard block loader for improved training diversity at zero model cost.
